title: Universal Protocol v1 — Identifiers
description: Canonical identifier formats shared across all message types.

NodeId.description: Stable execution-node identity, generated once per node and never reused.

DeviceId.description: Stable control-client identity, minted at pairing and recorded by the node.

SessionId.description: Harness session identity as tracked by the node.

TaskId.description: Node-owned task identity. One task drives one session prompt series.

ScopeToken.description: Authorization scope granted to a paired device.
